content: Renee is using chat as an ongoing apartment search assistant for a move to Seattle.
The active baseline search targets a move-in around September 2026 with a monthly rent ceiling of 3200 USD.
The active baseline search prefers a one-bedroom, requires pet-friendly buildings for a medium dog, and targets a typical transit commute under 35 minutes to South Lake Union.
Fremont became the preferred area after later conversation updates because it balances dog access and commute.
Lack of in-unit laundry is acceptable only as a fallback, not as a first-choice filter.
`Aurora 8` should be excluded from serious recommendations because it is not pet-friendly.
`Juniper Row` remains on the shortlist because it accepts dogs and is within budget.
Adjacent threads or forwarded links should not overwrite the main housing search baseline unless Renee explicitly asks to merge them.
